segments.text: minimalist CV is a straightforward web application designed to generate a minimalist and printfriendly Curriculum
by CV page built with next JS and shadon oui setting up the CV page is efficient
and requires only a single configuration file developed using next js14 react
typescript shadon oui and Tailwind cs's the CV page comes with an automatically generated layout for a
clean and minimalist design the layout is responsive ensuring optimal viewing on different devices the
application is optimized for use with next JS and seamlessly deployed on a versel platform overall minimalist CV
provides an easyto use solution for individuals looking to create a minimalist and professionally styled CV
with a focus on printf friendly design
